resources.string: Up to two. Uncheck one first.
Shows a search button in every chat header. It opens the same search as chat details. Applies on this device only.
Shows a mute button in every chat header. Muting asks for how long; unmuting applies right away. Applies on this device only.
Shows a read-aloud button in every chat header. It turns reading new messages aloud on or off for that chat, the same as in chat details. Applies on this device only.
The header shows up to two, in the order you check them.
